name: pca-connector-ad
description: Amazon Web Services Private CA Connector for Active Directory creates a connector between Amazon Web Services Private CA and Active Directory (AD) that enables you to provision security certificates for AD signed by a private CA that you own.

subcommands.name: create-connector
subcommands.description: Creates a connector between Amazon Web Services Private CA and an Active Directory.

subcommands.name: create-directory-registration
subcommands.description: Creates a directory registration that authorizes communication between Amazon Web Services Private CA and an Active Directory

subcommands.name: create-service-principal-name
subcommands.description: Creates a service principal name (SPN) for the service account in Active Directory.

subcommands.name: create-template
subcommands.description: Creates an Active Directory compatible certificate template.

subcommands.name: create-template-group-access-control-entry
subcommands.description: Create a group access control entry.

subcommands.name: delete-connector
subcommands.description: Deletes a connector for Active Directory.

subcommands.name: delete-directory-registration
subcommands.description: Deletes a directory registration.

subcommands.name: delete-service-principal-name
subcommands.description: Deletes the service principal name (SPN) used by a connector to authenticate with your Active Directory.

subcommands.name: delete-template
subcommands.description: Deletes a template.

subcommands.name: delete-template-group-access-control-entry
subcommands.description: Deletes a group access control entry.

subcommands.name: get-connector
subcommands.description: Lists information about your connector.

subcommands.name: get-directory-registration
subcommands.description: A structure that contains information about your directory registration.

subcommands.name: get-service-principal-name
subcommands.description: Lists the service principal name that the connector uses to authenticate with Active Directory.

subcommands.name: get-template
subcommands.description: Retrieves a certificate template that the connector uses to issue certificates from a private CA.

subcommands.name: get-template-group-access-control-entry
subcommands.description: Retrieves the group access control entries for a template.

subcommands.name: list-connectors
subcommands.description: Lists the connectors that you created by using the https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pca-connector-ad/latest/APIReference/API_CreateConnector action.

subcommands.name: list-directory-registrations
subcommands.description: Lists the directory registrations that you created by using the https://docs.aws.amazon.com/pca-connector-ad/latest/APIReference/API_CreateDirectoryRegistration action.

subcommands.name: list-service-principal-names
subcommands.description: Lists the service principal names that the connector uses to authenticate with Active Directory.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags, if any, that are associated with your resource.

subcommands.name: list-template-group-access-control-entries
subcommands.description: Lists group access control entries you created.

subcommands.name: list-templates
subcommands.description: Lists the templates, if any, that are associated with a connector.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to your resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags from your resource.

subcommands.name: update-template
subcommands.description: Update template configuration to define the information included in certificates.

subcommands.name: update-template-group-access-control-entry
subcommands.description: Update a group access control entry you created using CreateTemplateGroupAccessControlEntry.
